lines.en: label day214:
scene makotoistired1
It’s another normal day in class.
Well, normal apart from the fact that Makoto is sleeping, Maya and Chika are absent, Molly and Tsuneyo disappeared out of nowhere, and Yumi is skipping.
Actually, that last part is normal. But Maya is typically here and Chika’s stopped skipping altogether ever since I “gave up” on teaching.
It’s crazy how not assigning any[school]work can motivate students as much as this.
More teachers should give up on teaching and just let [teenager]s be [teenager]s.
I’m sure all these days of idle chit-chat and napping in class will prepare them for the future better than any chemistry or math lesson would.
scene makotoistired2
: Sensei! Can you tell Ayane to stop referring to this weird watermelon thingy as Maya?
: It’s not a “Weird watermelon thingy,” Ami. This is our good friend, Maya Makinami.
: Sensei, you didn’t mark Maya down as absent did you? I know it might be confusing that she switched seats, but I can assure you this is her.
menu:
Good morning, Maya
: Good morning, Maya. You look lovely today.
The watermelon remains silent as it is a watermelon.
And, in other news, I have suddenly stooped to Ayane’s level and thrown out any shred of humanity still left circulating throughout my body.
scene makotoistired3
: Am I the only normal person still left in this world?!
: Oh no. It appears we’ve made Ami upset.
: Sensei, do you think it might be good for her to spend some time alone in the nearest psychiatric hospital until she gets her thoughts back in place?
: I volunteer to move in and cook for you until she recovers. Which is hopefully not for a very long time.
: Preferably until after you give me at least one-
scene makotoistired4
: Say “child” and I will end you.
: Is “hug” acceptable instead or is that still too needy?
: You can have a handshake and that’s it.
Ayane pls
: Ayane, I can’t believe I have to tell you this, but that is not Maya.
: It is a watermelon.
scene makotoistired5
: No, no. You’ve got it all wrong. This is just Maya’s true form.
: You’ve seen how much she loves watermelons.
: Maybe her dreams finally came true and she just...became one! You can’t rule that out!
: As strange as that girl is, I think her dreams are a little different than that...
: Where is Maya anyway?
scene makotoistired6
: Right he-
: She was feeling really tired today so she decided to stay in the dorm.
: I tried tickling her to get her out of the bed but she doesn’t have a tickle-reflex so I was kind of just weirdly rubbing her belly for a minute or two.
: I’m sure it will be really awkward for both of us to look back on.
: Do you have a tickle-reflex, Sensei?
: Can I come over there and find out?
: Or would you rather come into the bathroom with me so I can take your clothes off and find out without several layers between my skin and yours?
scene makotoistired7
: Sorry to burst your bubble, but I can answer that question without the need for you to inconvenience Sensei at all.
: Of course he has a tickle-reflex. I have firsthand experience with it.
: I tickle him all the time.
: You have not tickled me once.
At least that I can remember.
: Does he now? I’d still like to experience this on my own to confirm.
: Maybe the two of us could do it together since I’m apparently not allowed to lure him into a bathroom by myself.
: No thanks. You can go tickle Maya.
: In fact, I encourage you to do that so she doesn’t think I’m the weird one anymore.
: If you do it for like two minutes you’ll probably break my record.
: As long as she wears her Halloween costume, I support this.
Is it a little too narcissistic for me to want to see that?
It’s not, right?
I’m a totally normal human teacher who just wants to see a [young_girl] dressing up as him be tickled by an equally [young_girl].
This is a normal desire for a male to have.
: Hehehehe...
I suddenly feel the fingers of a certain Irish girl find their way to my waist and begin to rapidly move back and forth amidst her giggling.
: Molly, what are you doing?
: Succeeding where others have not, Sir!
: Fall victim to my fingertips, overflowing with the radiant energy of the seventh sun!
A...second set of fingertips suddenly joins Molly’s near my ribs.
I do not react because I am too stoic and unwavering to have a so-called “tickle reflex.”
: Fall victim to my fingers as well, bro.
: Good morning, Tsuneyo.
: Ah-
scene makotoistired8

I turn around to find both residents of Dorm Room 6, who have just finished attempting to tickle me for some reason, standing up against the chalkboard that I have used maybe twice since I started teaching.
: How long have you two been there?
: Since the first bell tolled, of course!
: The Kendo Princess jumped into my shroud of concealment and we were able to sneak behind you without so much a hint of being detected.
: It was my first time becoming invisible. I felt very excited.
: Congratulations, Tsuneyo.
scene makotoistired9
: Ah-
: Anyway, what do the two of you want?
: All we want is your undying attention and enlistment into our ever-growing army.
: And perhaps several thousand headpats and a chance to entwine our fingers in-
scene makotoistired10
: Uhh...
: Ts...Tsuneyo?
: If this was all you wanted, I could have done it.
: Your hair is surprisingly soft. What type of conditioner do you use?
: We use the same bottle...
: What were you saying about entwining fingers?
: Would you like to hold hands as well?
scene makotoistired11
: Uhh...No. I was just joking about that.
: Your cheeks show your true desires. Come. Join hands with me.
scene makotoistired12
: Get yer’ friggin’ hand off my head! The yuri tag is still a ways off!
: Yuri tag?
scene makotoistired13
: Uhh...anyway!
: We’re...here to tell you that we talked to the principal.
: The principal? About what?
: You know...all that stuff we said at the Halloween party before I got totally hammered and started rantin’ about my dad.
scene makotoistired14
: I believe she is referring to how the two of us started crying when we found out you would not be teaching us again next year.
: Even though you really haven’t taught us this year, either.
: Yes, I got that.
: I didn’t know you two talked to the principal, though. Makoto should have told me about something like that.
scene makotoistired15
: Well, we did! And boy do I have some great news to share with you!
: Wait, were you really approved to be in my class again next year?
Not like it matters if this cycle is just going to repeat again soon anyway.
But I’m glad these two cared enough to go to the effort of actually doing something about their troubles rather than just sitting back and accepting them.
That’s actually kind of admirable- especially for these two misfits.
: Oh, heck no. We weren’t approved at all.
: Oh.
: Well then what’s the good news?
: The good news is that we weren’t not-approved either.
: So it was basically just a maybe?
: Correct. But maybe doesn’t mean no!
: So if the stars align, there is a chance you have not seen the last of Molly MacCormack, Sir!
: In fact, there is no way you have seen the last of Molly MacCormack! This is still her introductory arc!
scene makotoistired16
: Mine as well. The two of us have not even lost Virginia yet.
: I still don’t fully understand what that means, but I know it will be an important obstacle to overcome on the path to womanhood.
: Right-o, Tsuney-o. If you wind up losing Virginia before me, though, I’m throwing down Damnation.
: That sounds scary.
: Very scary. It destroys all creatures. They can’t be regenerated either.
: I don’t know much about regeneration, but I am almost positive that I am a creature.
: Is Virginia really the term we’re using now?
scene makotoistired17
: Oh-ho-ho~ Have you caught on to what Virginia means, Sir?
: A typical visual novel protagonist wouldn’t connect all of those dots for at least another twenty hours.
: Yeah, I think I’ve made it pretty apparent that I’m not exactly “typical” so far.
: That just means there’s more of a chance for me to succeed. Especially without the presence of a childhood-friend heroine.
: Molly says my archetype is “The one without a real shot.”
: It sounded offensive when I heard it but I don’t know what this “shot” is in regard to anyway, so I should not be upset just yet.
: Good luck, Tsuneyo.
: You definitely do have a shot, though.
scene makotoistired18
: I do?
: She does?!
: Of course. What kind of protagonist would I be to rule anyone out without giving them a chance?
: I want to rejoice, but I still don’t understand what the shot is.
scene makotoistired19
: So...it appears that even your closest allies can be your enemies under the right circumstances.
: Are we enemies now?
: Not yet. But the inevitable turn has begun.
: The clock has started to tick and, whether you like it or not, all shall come tumbling down eventually, Kendo Princess.
: This battle is only now beginning. And I will not lose to your tanned, womanly charms for I am a proud daughter of the Emerald Isle and GUYS LOVE LOLI CHARACTERS!
: Didn’t you say you were slowly slipping away from the loli tag, though?
scene makotoistired20
: GAH! DO NOT REMIND ME!
: I feel like I’ve made a terrible mistake by simply existing.
scene makotoistired21
Molly storms off and Tsuneyo immediately follows after her, leaving me staring confusedly at the chalkboard that, once again, I have only used twice.
: Do not follow me, Kendo Princess! All of my defensive abilities are on cooldown!
: I must follow you. No one else ever talks to me.
: That’s because you’re weird and only talk about noodles!
: Loving noodles is not a crime. Do you need me to pat your head again?
: Leave me alone!
Huh...
I hope the fact that two of them talked to the principal doesn’t get me in trouble.
I can’t imagine that conversation went well or...even understandable for that matter.
Maybe Makoto will know since I’ve never really dealt with anything like that before?
scene black
I turn back around and accidentally knock over a stack of papers on my desk, forcing me to bend down and pick them all up before making my way over to Makoto.
Typically, she’d jump out of her seat and offer to get them all for me, but she seems rather...
scene makotoistired22
Off today...
: Makoto?
Makoto remains as still as a statue with her head pressed up against her forearm.
I glance over at Miku to see if she has anything to say about Makoto’s current state, but instead of saying anything or even looking at me, a worried look swallows her face.
: Hey. Wake up.
I begin to snap my fingers, hoping the noise will wake Makoto from her slumber(?).
She does not move.
I guess this is what Maki was talking about the other day when she said Makoto had been acting...out of it?
That being said, it doesn’t look like she was able to make any progress if she’s still acting however she’s-
scene makotoistired23
: Oh, Sensei.
: Good morning~
: Good morning...
: What happened to you?
: Nothing.
: I’m the same...diligent Makoto Miyamura, student council president and class representative.
: My favorite color is blue and I work in a porn shop.
: Do you have anything for me to do?
: I’ll do anything you want.
: Yes, actually.
: How about you go home for the day?
scene makotoistired24
: And ruin my perfect attendance? Hahaha...Very funny, Sensei.
: If I didn’t know any better, I’d think you were fucking oblivious being serious.
: I’ll stay right here.
: I’m just a liiiiiittle bit tired so I might...doze off every now and then...
The bags under her eyes reveal more than just lack of sleep.
They’re swollen as if she’s been crying for decades straight.
Like every ounce of water in her body has exited through her eyes and left nothing but the shell of a girl who normally seems so serious.
Even her uniform is out of sorts.
: I think the two of us need to talk.
scene makotoistired25
: Why?
: Want me to blow you?
: Ma...Makoto! The heck are you sayin’ to Sensei?!
: What’s goin’ on with you?
Miku stands up from her desk and whispers as loud as a whisper can be so as to not alert the rest of the class.
scene makotoistired26
: Ooooh, Miku’s here!
: That’s right...I’m in class...
: I’ve gotta watch what I say or somebody might think I’m a slut.
: What the heck are you talkin’ about?...
: Weren’t you gonna stay home today? Your mom’s been freakin’ out about you and you’re-
: I’m what?
: Tell me, Miku.
: What am I?
: ...You’re friggin’ scary lookin' right now.
: And you’re saying stuff to the teacher that you’d never say if you were feelin’ okay.
: What’s wrong? You wanna blow him too?
: Wha-?!
scene makotoistired27
: How does two girls at once sound, Sensei?
: Plus, we’re best friends so just think of the...fucking synergy...
: That’s it! You’re comin’ with me!
: Sensei! I don’t know what the heck is goin’ on with Makoto, but don’t take anythin’ she’s sayin’ today seriously!
: Miku Maruyama’s gettin’ to the bottom of this!
scene black
Miku grabs Makoto by the wrist and begins to drag her out of the class.
Everyone else has noticed by now.
Not noticing would be impossible.
They all look at me to gauge my reaction once the two of them have left the classroom.
But, not knowing what else to do, I just go back to leaning against my desk and I guess the rest of the girls decide it’s not anything serious.
That or they pretend not to.
What’s going on with her?
$ day214 = True
Makoto’s affection is affectionate!
